verdict.rationale: Shopify's own marketing page explicitly claims B2B selling alongside DTC ('Sell to businesses and consumers from one platform... all the B2B features you need'), confirming the axis applies and is marketed as supported. However, the evidence pack contains no detail on the specific mechanics named in the story — customer-specific price lists, volume/tiered pricing, quote workflows, or net-terms invoicing. Missing for 10: documentation of price-list/volume-pricing features, quote-to-order workflow, net-terms/invoicing support, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of B2B functionality.
